name: Fracture +3 Skills at 1/3 (Abyss mark)
summary: Get a fractured +3 to Level of all Melee Skills on a 4-mod amulet with a 1 in 3 instead of 1 in 4 chance: turn a prefix into a desecrated mod first, because desecrated mods cannot be fractured.
source: YouTube: +4 skill amulet crafting tech (chapter "Getting Fractures")
keyIdeas: A Fracturing Orb needs at least 4 modifiers and picks one of the fracturable ones at random.
Desecrated modifiers (revealed or not) count towards the 4 modifiers, but can never be fractured.
Essence of the Abyss adds "Mark of the Abyssal Lord"; the next bone consumes the mark and puts the unrevealed desecrated modifier into its slot.
So one of four modifiers becomes unfracturable: the fracture hits the wanted +3 with 1/3 instead of 1/4.

steps.title: Mark a prefix
steps.explanation: The essence removes a random modifier and adds the Mark of the Abyssal Lord in its slot. Omen of Sinistral Crystallisation limits the removal to prefixes, so the +3 skills suffix is safe.
steps.onMiss: Cannot miss: every prefix may go, the mark always lands on a prefix.

steps.title: Desecrate the mark
steps.explanation: A bone on a marked item replaces the mark with an unrevealed desecrated modifier. The item still has 4 modifiers, but only 3 of them can be fractured now.

steps.title: Fracture the +3 skills
steps.explanation: The fracture picks one of the 3 fracturable modifiers. A fractured +3 skills can't be removed by any later step, which makes the +4 technique safe.
steps.onMiss: Another mod got fractured: reveal the desecrated mod and sell the amulet (good spirit/defence fractures still have value), then start with a new base.

nextSteps: Reveal the desecrated modifier at the Well of Souls — a good reveal adds value even when the fracture missed.
Continue with the guide "+4 Melee Skills Amulet".

name: +4 Melee Skills Amulet
summary: Turn a fractured +3 to Level of all Melee Skills into +4: Essence of the Breach raises the maximum quality to 40%, Reaver (attack) catalyst quality of 34% or more lifts +3 to +4, and Omen of Whittling removes the temporary Breach modifier again.
source: YouTube: +4 skill amulet crafting tech (chapter "4 Melee Amulet")
keyIdeas: Catalyst quality increases the values of modifiers with its tag: +3 melee skills (attack tag) × 1.34 = 4.02 → +4. At 33% it stays +3 (whole numbers round down).
Normal maximum quality is 20%. Essence of the Breach adds "+20% to Maximum Quality" (40% total).
Blocker: add a throwaway modifier on the same side as the fracture, so a side-restricted removal (Crystallisation) can only take that one.
The Breach modifier has level 1: Omen of Whittling (removes the lowest-level modifier) takes it off with certainty. The quality stays (as shown in the video; the simulator assumes it).
Optional bonus: while the quality is still free, defence catalysts + Omen of Catalysing Exaltation push a defensive prefix before the Reaver quality is applied.

steps.title: Add a suffix blocker
steps.explanation: The fracture is a suffix, so add a throwaway suffix. It is the only removable suffix now — the next side-restricted removal must take it. A lucky roll (rarity, resistances) can be kept instead and the plan adapted.

steps.title: +20% Maximum Quality
steps.explanation: The essence removes a suffix (only the blocker is removable — the +3 is fractured) and adds "+20% to Maximum Quality" as a prefix. The amulet can now hold 40% catalyst quality.

steps.title: Defence quality for Catalysing Exaltation (optional)
steps.explanation: 40% defence quality makes defensive modifiers much more likely on the next Exalted Orb with Omen of Catalysing Exaltation. Skip steps 3 and 4 if you only want the +4.

steps.title: Defensive prefix
steps.explanation: Sinistral Exaltation forces a prefix, Catalysing Exaltation consumes the defence quality and multiplies the weight of defence modifiers (strength of the bonus is an assumption in config). The quality is used up — the Reaver quality comes next.
steps.onMiss: A non-defence prefix: keep it if acceptable, otherwise remove it later (it is not the lowest level, so not with Whittling).

steps.title: Attack quality: +3 becomes +4
steps.explanation: Reaver catalysts add attack quality. At 34% or more the fractured +3 to Level of all Melee Skills works as +4 (7 uses → 35%).

steps.title: Whittle off the Breach modifier
steps.explanation: Omen of Whittling makes the Chaos Orb remove the lowest-level modifier: the level-1 Breach modifier. The Chaos Orb then adds a random modifier. The +4 stays because the quality stays. If an unrevealed desecrated modifier were on the item, it would count as level 1 — reveal it first.
steps.onMiss: Cannot miss while no unrevealed desecrated modifier is on the item.

nextSteps: If the Chaos Orb added a suffix: Omen of Dextral Crystallisation + Perfect Essence of Enhancement turns it into a guaranteed defensive prefix modifier.
Suffixes: Preserved Collarbone, then blockers with high weight and low value (life regeneration, attributes) before rerolling; Omen of Light removes a bad desecrated mod.
Ancient Collarbone + Omen of Abyssal Echoes more than doubles the odds for a good desecrated suffix — worth it when it costs about twice a normal attempt.

name: +4 Spell Skills Amulet (fractured Spirit)
summary: The inverse route: spirit is fractured, +3 to Level of all Spell Skills was chaos-spammed. Blocker on the prefix side, Essence of the Breach, Sibilant (caster) catalysts to 34%+, then whittle the Breach modifier off.
source: YouTube: +4 skill amulet crafting tech (chapter "4 Spell Amulet")
keyIdeas: Starting with a spirit fracture guarantees the spirit and lets you chaos for any of the +3 skills (melee, spell, minion, projectile ≈ 400 weight together).
Only spell (caster tag) and melee (attack tag) skills can be lifted by catalysts — minion and projectile skills can't.
The fracture is a prefix now, so the blocker and the crystallisation go on the prefix side.

steps.title: Add a prefix blocker
steps.explanation: Spirit is the fractured prefix, so the throwaway modifier goes to the prefixes: afterwards it is the only removable prefix.

steps.title: +20% Maximum Quality
steps.explanation: Sinistral Crystallisation restricts the removal to prefixes — only the blocker can go. The Breach modifier takes its place.

steps.title: Caster quality: +3 becomes +4
steps.explanation: Sibilant catalysts add caster quality. At 34% or more +3 to Level of all Spell Skills works as +4.

steps.title: Whittle off the Breach modifier
steps.explanation: The Breach modifier has level 1 and is removed with certainty; the Chaos Orb adds a random modifier in exchange. The quality — and the +4 — stay.
steps.onMiss: Cannot miss while no unrevealed desecrated modifier is on the item.

nextSteps: Cast speed is one of the best suffixes for casters: Skittering (speed) catalysts + Omen of Catalysing Exaltation favour it — but that consumes the caster quality, so do it before the Sibilant catalysts or re-apply them afterwards.
Finish the suffixes with bones and blockers like in the melee guide.
